supporting_pages.title: "Migrate code with the batch SQL translator \_|\_ BigQuery \_|\_ Google Cloud\
evidence_snippets: In the code tab, you can examine the files used in a translation job, review a side-by-side comparison of an input file and its translation for any inaccuracies, and view log summaries and messages for a specific file in a job.
Migrate code with the batch SQL translator Note: For API-based translations, including new batch translations, we recommend that you use the BigQuery Migration API to translate your SQL scripts.

supporting_pages.title: "Transform SQL translations using configuration YAML files \_|\_ BigQuery\
evidence_snippets: You can specify a configuration YAML file to use in a SQL translation in the following ways: If you are using the interactive SQL translator, specify the file path to the configuration file or batch translation job ID in the translation settings .

The interactive SQL translator, BigQuery Migration API, the batch SQL translator, and the batch translation Python client supports the use of multiple configuration YAML files in a single translation job.

When using the BigQuery interactive SQL translator , using the BigQuery Migration API , or performing a batch SQL translation , you can provide configuration YAML files to modify a SQL query translation.
